description: This file contains function declarations and inline implementations for string manipulation, specifically for stripping prefixes and suffixes from strings, as part of the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: ConsumePrefix
methods.description: Removes the specified prefix from the start of a string view if present, returning true if successful.

methods.name: ConsumeSuffix
methods.description: Removes the specified suffix from the end of a string view if present, returning true if successful.

methods.name: StripPrefix
methods.description: Returns a string view with the specified prefix removed if it exists, otherwise returns the original string view.

methods.name: StripSuffix
methods.description: Returns a string view with the specified suffix removed if it exists, otherwise returns the original string view.
